items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: The interviewee discusses Olivier Major only in response to the interviewer's prompt listing people ('Olivier Major played and your father Albert Hall Sr.'), but the interviewee does not confirm a personal relationship or specific interaction with Olivier Major, instead shifting the topic to Lawrenc

ctx.x: Oh yeah, because my father was the youngest and they had about three of them, older than my daddy and he was the oldest. That's right.
Who did Oliver Jones or Olivier, I want to know about that?

Who did he play with? Well he played with different bands in the city, he played here in the Orleans. A fellow they called Bush, Kid Bush, I don't know if you ever heard of him. You see a long time ago that's the way they used to call bands.
